headline: Canadian PM Carney Says US Tariffs Drive Up Costs for American Families
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that U.S. tariffs have increased costs for American families and disrupted decades-old trade relations, while unveiling a multibillion-dollar plan to shield Canada's manufacturing sector.
why: Cross-border tariffs alter supply chain costs and bilateral trade flows between the United States and Canada, impacting industrial manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Trade tariffs create headwinds for manufacturing exporters, prompting government support packages to shield domestic industries.
